name: Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Doing Business

requirements.blocker_text: Requires confirmation of registration in the Trade Licensing Register or Commercial Register (or equivalent) for self-employment or professional business activity. No fixed minimum capital/investment amount is specified.
requirements.fix_path: Register the qualifying trade licence or business entity.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate adequate total monthly income to support residence in Czechia.

evidence_required.document: Trade Licensing Register or Commercial Register confirmation

sources.title: ipc.gov.cz -- Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Doing Business: trade/commercial registration, proof of funds, 2-year duration, extension window

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Notably low-barrier compared to cz_investment_residence: no minimum capital figure is required here, only trade/commercial registration and proof of adequate income -- this is the ordinary self-employment/freelance business route (the same underlying trade licence, zivnostensky list, that also underlies cz_digital_nomad_program's freelance track). Extension applications must be filed between 120 days before and the final day of validity. family_can_join set false: not addressed in the source for this permit specifically (family members would apply separately via cz_family_reunification once the sponsor has held qualifying status).
